piechart.description: Pie and donut charts share PieChart. Set innerRadius for a donut with center summaries and side-by-side legends.
piechart.donutDescription: All chart demos use a 180px size. Slices have a 2px gap and 4px corners; the pixel gap is converted to padAngle for that size. The chart and legend sit side by side on desktop and stack on narrow screens.
piechart.remainderDescription: The explicit total is 100, with 92 allocated. The remaining 8 is a neutral slice; percentages use 100 as the denominator. The center shows the allocated value by default and the inspected slice during hover or keyboard navigation.
piechart.contract: innerRadius=0 renders a pie; a positive radius renders a donut. Radii and hoverOffset use pixels; angles use radians. Input order is preserved; finite non-negative values determine the total. Invalid slices retain their index without visible geometry. When a business total exceeds allocated values, append an explicit neutral remainder slice to preserve the denominator. Unknown totals must remain unknown. Default hover is translate by 10px, innerRadius=0, padAngle=0 and cornerRadius=0. Geometry scrubbing skips Motion path morphing. Explicitly assign colors when items can reorder. Custom PieCenter rendering applies to both idle and hover states.
piechart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect data, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. Reduced motion disables decorative loops. ChartLegend layout/overflow are API options; inline/collapse fits multiple entries and folds overflow.
piechart.compatibility: DonutChart documentation and examples are merged here; existing links redirect to PieChart. Import shared tooltip and legend from chart-core. DonutSummary used by existing blocks, chart/Recharts and chart-primitives retain their compatibility APIs.
